evidence_semantics_notes.single_hsp_reference_coverage: Computed as (abs(send - sstart) + 1) / slen for the single best-bitscore HSP, strictly bounded in (0, 1]. Gapped alignment_length is recorded separately and never divided by slen. Query is a DNA contig (qlen in bp), so coverage is reference protein span coverage, never query protein coverage.
evidence_semantics_notes.selected_candidate_reference_unique: Denotes that mapped reference sequences are not shared with another reaction among the 63 selected candidate reactions. Broad EC/MetaCyc crosswalks may include proteins with multiple substrate activities; this does not prove reaction-specific catalysis.
evidence_semantics_notes.homolog_candidate_detected_in_MAG: Interior contig hit with bitscore >= 50, pident >= 40, and single-HSP reference coverage >= 0.70. Uncalled vs annotation-miss status is unknown because hits are not intersected against called ORF coordinates.
